vexation:
n. 惱怒, 煩惱, 令人惱火的事情

n anger produced by some annoying irritation
n the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed
vexatious:
a. 叫人發急的, 使人為難的, 無理纏訟的

vexed: a. 煩惱的, 焦急的, 生氣的, 為難的, 惱怒的, 爭論不休的
